entities.summary: Bah Ndaw is a Malian retired military officer and politician who served as the interim president of Mali from 2020 to 2021, when he was deposed in a coup. He previously served as the Minister of Defense and Veterans Affairs in the government of President Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta from 2014 to 2015.
